tasks.title: Define hypothetical world capture and pure builtin preview
tasks.goal: Compute legal scenarios from frozen inputs using existing resolver/compiler semantics.
steps: Bind baseline/candidate source captures, choices, target conditions and expected world identity.
Run supported pure builtin compilation in memory without installing/publishing candidate state.
Represent legal static/dynamic placements and explicit incompatible/incomplete stages through the shared request/result protocol.
positive_cases: Prepared identical scenario yields identical hypothetical graph and metrics.
negative_cases: Illegal loading override refuses instead of secretly changing the package.
Changed catalog/capture makes preview stale; native stage is not invoked implicitly.

tasks.title: Separate effectful preparation from snapshot inspection
tasks.goal: Make missing sources and native stages explicit admitted preparation work.
steps: Create explicit prepare operations for required fetch/hydration/native preview stages using M-16/M-14 grants.
Present effects and exact inputs before execution; retain immutable preview evidence for later pure readers.
Expose needs-preparation/unavailable when admission or provider capability is absent, without hidden fallback.
positive_cases: Admitted preparation creates a captured result subsequently inspected without effects.
negative_cases: Empty-cache inspect never hydrates; revoked provider is not rerun to open retained evidence.
Preparation cannot mutate installed project manifest/lock/slots/boot.
